newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woolworths says chairman has died.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woolworths says chairman has died.

text.p: Retailer Woolworths Ltd said on Monday its chairman John Iliffe died on May 24 and that deputy chairman John Phillips would be acting as chairman for the time being.
Woolworths announced on May 16 that Iliffe had undergone surgery and would not be in a position to act as chairman for the time being and that Phillips would be acting chairman.
Iliffe was also chairman of insurance group GIO Australia Holdings Ltd. In a joint statement with Woolworths on May 16, GIO said Stanley Howard would be its acting chairman.
Woolworths did not give any more details on Iliffe's death.
Iliffe was also president of the Sydney organising committee for the Sydney 2000 Olympic Games for six months until last September.

He was replaced by local politician Michael Knight, the New South Wales state Olympics minister, after the International Olympic Committee decided that the Sydney Games would need unambiguous political support.
Iliffe was also the former chairman of gaming machine maker AWA Ltd until his resignation in March. He was replaced by Trevor Kennedy.
